title: Delivery manifest
description: Obligations that may travel on a runtime carrier instead of standing context, and what happens to each when that carrier is unavailable. Contract: docs/contracts/resident-process-floors.md § 3. Resolver: src/scripts/_lib/delivery_criticality.ts.

id.description: Logical obligation id — the rule, gate or floor being delivered.

criticality.description: critical-A never migrates off standing context. critical-B may migrate and is delivered EAGERLY when the carrier is unavailable, never dropped. standard may fail open. Required here even though the resolver defaults an omitted value to critical-B: a manifest is authored, and an author who has not decided should be made to, while a RUNTIME value that is merely absent must still fail closed.

carrier.description: The runtime carrier that would deliver this obligation.

why.description: Why this class and not the next one down. Required by review, not by schema.
